title: Seeing Is Not Addressing: Auditing Linguistic Access to Frozen Visual Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2609.37230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual distinctions are often finer than those reflected in linguistic conceptualization. Vision-language models exhibit a similar asymmetry: a distinction can remain discriminable in frozen image geometry while being weakly addressable through the native text interface. We study this gap by separating visual discriminability from linguistic addressability in text-to-image retrieval. Using FactorAtlas, a fully crossed testbed of 23,040 images spanning shape, hue, pattern, and nuisance variation, we compare both readouts on held-out images of the same distinctions. We then derive image-side contrasts that separate each value from its alternatives for matched visual grounding, and test whether this reduces the native-text access gap across factors and models. translated_title: 看见并不等于可寻址：对冻结视觉几何的语言可及性审计
translated_abstract: 视觉上的差异往往比语言概念化所能反映的更为精细。视觉-语言模型也表现出类似的不对称性：某种差异可能在冻结的图像几何中依然可分辨，但通过原生文本接口却难以寻址与表达。我们在文本到图像检索中把视觉可分辨性与语言可寻址性分离开来，以此研究这一差距。我们使用 FactorAtlas——一个包含 23,040 张图像、涵盖形状、色调、图案与干扰变化的完全交叉测试平台——在同一差异的保留图像上对两种读出方式进行对比。随后，我们推导出图像侧的视觉对比，将每个取值与其备选取值区分开，以实现匹配的视觉锚定，并检验这是否能缩小不同因素与不同模型下的原生文本访问差距。方向特异性控制与视觉缺失控制将这些增益与相关视觉对比联系起来；这些增益在全局对齐后依然保持，并延伸至组合式检索与自然语（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究揭示了视觉-语言模型中“视觉可分辨”与“语言可寻址”之间的不对称性，构建了包含 23,040 张图像的 FactorAtlas 全交叉测试平台，并证明通过推导图像侧的视觉对比，可以缩小冻结视觉几何与原生文本接口之间的访问差距。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals an asymmetry in vision-language models where visual distinctions remain discriminable in frozen image geometry but are weakly addressable through the native text interface, and introduces FactorAtlas—23,040 fully-crossed images—showing that deriving image-side contrasts reduces this native-text access gap.
